# Noticias Médicas

> > Spanish-language medical news platform covering healthcare technology, artificial intelligence in medicine, digital health innovations, and healthcare policy developments.

Noticias Médicas provides comprehensive coverage of the Spanish healthcare landscape, focusing on technological advancements including AI-driven medical transcription, clinical record automation, and digital medicine solutions. The site also reports on healthcare policy, government initiatives, and hospital infrastructure investments, featuring key stakeholders like the Ministerio de Sanidad y Seguridad Social and political figures such as Arlindo do Rosário.

## Key Topics

- Inteligencia Artificial en Medicina
- Medicina Digital
- Transcripción Médica Automatizada
- Historia Clínica Electrónica
- Automatización Sanitaria
- Ministerio de Sanidad y Seguridad Social
- Política Sanitaria
- Inversión Hospitalaria
- Equipamiento Hospitalario
- Gobierno y Sanidad
- Tecnología Médica
- Parlamento
- Arlindo do Rosário

- [Tecnologia archivos - Noticias Médicas](https://www.noticiasmedicas.es/tecnologia/): Medical technology news: AI, digital medicine, clinical records automation
